profile.headline: Enterprise Solution Architect
profile.summary:
**During 20 years in Software Development, I work with several teams to build, integrate and consult software products. Some (but not limited to) of technology/tools that I have been using so far are listed below.
I'm passionate about Applied Sciences, focusing on Software Development - Cloud computing, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Big Data Science, Robotics and other AI areas. 

++ Object Oriented languages and services (on-premises or on Cloud): JAVA, JavaScript, SQL, REST APIs, AWS services, payment gateway, Google map, Android Studio, Eclipse, Python, Json, Gson 

++ AI tools: Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, PCA, SVM, Cross Validation, K-NN, Naïve Bayes, Clustering, Ensemble Methods, CNN, RNN, NLP. Tools:, Python, Tensorflow, Scikit-learn, Keras, Numpy

++ Project Management: Deliver projects that meet client’s expectation on time, within budget, and in good quality. Received “The Best Project Manager” award in year 2009 for strong people connection, scope management and risk management
++ Domain: Healthcare (including FACETS/QNXT framework), E-commerce, E-learning

SPECIALTIES: 
+ Computer Sciences
+ Software Development
+ Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Big Data Sciences
+ Requirement Analyzing
+ Project Management
+ Quality Assurance

positions.title: Solution Architect/Software Engineer
positions.description:
Fantastic massage (FMS) – startup (Java SQL Android Rest APIs AWS project)
	•	Designed and developed large-scale enterprise Java micro services to support and enhance an Android application, overseeing all technical aspects including design, coding, testing, and delivery.
	•	Created architecture and built web services (RESTful APIs, XML, JSON, GSON, HTML, JavaScript) to facilitate seamless communication between the Android application and MSSQL server.
	•	Deployed web services on Amazon Web Services (AWS), utilizing EC2, Elastic Beanstalk, S3, RDS, IAM and Cognito, and other related services to ensure robust and scalable solutions.
	•	Managed Android application deployment to Google Cloud, ensuring efficient and reliable service delivery.
	•	Designed and implemented relational databases on MSSQL server, including schema design and optimization to support application requirements.
	•	Developed and enforced security models, ensuring data protection and compliance with industry standards.
	•	Created and integrated accounting models, supporting financial transactions and reporting requirements.
	•	Integrated with Google Maps, Java Mail, and HTTP/HTTPS protocols to enhance application functionality.
	•	Implemented payment gateway integration using Braintree and Stripe services to facilitate secure and efficient transactions.
	•	Configured and managed database servers, resolving complex systems and database issues to maintain high performance and reliability.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · REST APIs · Java

positions.title: Enterprise Architect - Consulting Manager at Change Healthcare
positions.description:
I build/customize software products and follow the nature.
I use AWS, Rest APIs, SQL, JSON, Jackson, XML, HL7, EDI, Facets, QNXT, ect.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · REST APIs · Java

positions.title: Senior Consultant (System Integration)
positions.description:
•	FACETS – Healthcare Insurance Framework, Healthcare, JAVA, .NET, Oracle, SQL, Sybase
•	Customize healthcare solutions using Facets Enrollment Toolkit (FET), Trizetto Medicare Solution (TMS), Enrollment Administration Manager (EAM), Hosted Batch Architecture (HBA)
•	Produce FACETS products to automate workflow in every aspect of the healthcare business, including Member Enrollment, Claim Processing, Billing, Care Management, Provider Network Management, Authorization among other functionalities
•	Build Inbound, Outbound customized solutions involving EDI, X12 format files 
•	Manage offshore team and report progress on daily basic
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · REST APIs · Java · Facets

positions.title: Technical Lead - Project Manager
positions.description:
•	QNXT, EMS - Web Application, Healthcare, .NET, MSSQL
•	Managed offshore team to develop Exceptions Management System (EMS), a central place to manage healthcare exceptions extracted from QNXT during daily operation; cooperated with onshore team to code and deploy patches to production environment
•	Served as liaison between end users and offshore team
•	Interviewed and gained business need from client, clarify requirements and transfer to development team 
•	Estimated time and resource for requirement development 
•	Created Project Plan, Business Requirement Document (BRD), Traceability Matrix
•	Created Mockups, Database Schema, Storyboards, Requirement Specification

positions.title: Sr. Project Manager II/Supervisor
positions.description:
•	Delivered projects against the scope documents within time and budget
•	Coordinated, allocated and utilized resources efficiently
•	Ensured adherence to specified project and development standards
•	Communicated with all levels across organization lines
•	Ensured project resources are given necessary information so they can perform the role efficiently
•	Created regular and ad hoc management and project reports in a timely manner
•	Made timely decisions on project changes to minimize any disruption
•	Facilitated the timely resolution of project issues
•	Ensured handover between functions groups was accurate and timely
